diag18.scope: Fixed reference rectangles, not rendered material IDs. A color transition proves an observed response there; continuous alpha can combine opaque and inline layers. It does not prove all pixels/materials/kernels.

limits: Measures actual report fields and decoded screenshot pixels only; no UE process or new capture was run by this script.
Fixed image rectangles are not material IDs; alpha mixing can obscure or combine packed/inline responses.
Source Opacity is a material scalar, not the resulting per-pixel alpha or an independently measured compositing weight.
Camera location/FOV and facefix global rotation are recorded, but full PP/exposure and per-image rotation are not.
CPU lifecycle checks and exit0 do not prove shader paths; declared diagnostic/threshold observations are separate checks.
Even all listed checks passing does not prove all GPU kernels, arbitrary meshes, lights or final Endfield image fidelity.
